changes.before: Enchant one friendly ranged-capable stack for 3 rounds. After each ranged creature attack that deals damage, the damaged enemy stack gains one Arcane Breach mark; the hit that applies a mark does not benefit from it. A stack can hold at most 3 marks, and applying a mark refreshes all existing marks to 2 rounds. Focus Magic captures its caster's Spell Power-derived penetration when cast, and each mark copies that value: min(20%, 10% + 0.05% x Spell Power x Sorcery rank coefficient). Under saved v3 rules, the coefficient is 100% with no rank, 115% at Basic, 130% at Advanced, and 145% at Expert; it scales only the Spell Power term, leaving the 10% base unchanged. Saved v1/v2 profiles use 100% at every Sorcery rank. Subsequent friendly ranged creature attacks ignore that much Creature Defense; Creature Defense is not reduced, and melee attacks gain no benefit.

Saved v1/v2 profiles use 100% at every Sorcery rank. changes.before: Teleport one friendly or enemy stack to a random legal position within min(4, 2 + floor(Spell Power / 100)) hexes, excluding its origin and fitting its whole footprint. Intervening blockers and Zones of Control do not matter. No new action, retaliation, Initiative or voluntary-movement benefit. Chaos rank strengthens only the Spell Power term. Blinkmaster draws two independent legal destinations and automatically chooses the farther, breaking equal-distance ties by hex order. No legal destination means no Mana or Hero Action is spent.
changes.after:
Teleport one friendly or enemy stack to a random nearby position. It must fit there, and cannot stay where it is. Blink ignores intervening blockers and Zones of Control. It grants no extra action or Initiative, does not refresh retaliation, and gives no benefit for voluntary movement. If no legal destination exists, no Mana or Hero Action is spent.

Range: min(4, 2 + floor(Spell Power / 100)) hexes. Chaos rank strengthens only the Spell Power part. Blinkmaster draws two legal destinations independently and uses the farther one; ties use hex order.

changes.before: The target's next activation becomes Attack, Defend or Wander, chosen randomly. Attack approaches its chosen enemy if no attack is in reach; if no legal attack or approach is possible, it Defends. Wander also Defends if no legal destination exists. Applying Confusion removes Berserk. A negative Morale forfeiture consumes Confusion. Dispel removes pending Confusion.
changes.after:
Confuse one enemy stack for its next activation. It randomly attacks one of its enemies, Defends, or wanders to a random legal position. It does not attack its allies.

If the chosen enemy is out of reach, the stack approaches it. If it cannot attack or approach, or has nowhere to wander, it Defends. Confusion removes Berserk. Losing the activation to negative Morale also consumes Confusion; Dispel can remove it before it takes effect.

changes.before: Protect one friendly stack for 2 rounds. Each enemy creature that damages it becomes Judged and takes Holy damage at round's end: min(30% of its damage dealt to the protected stack that round, 25 + 1.25 x Spell Power). Each attacker triggers once per round. Light rank strengthens only the Spell Power term; Retributionist increases final reactive damage by 20%. Spells do not trigger it.
changes.after:
For 2 rounds, enemy creatures that damage one chosen friendly stack are Judged and suffer Holy damage at the end of the round. Spells do not trigger this effect.

Each attacker is punished once per round for 30% of the damage it dealt to the protected stack, capped at 25 + 1.25 x Spell Power. Light rank strengthens only the Spell Power part. Retributionist increases the resulting reactive damage by 20%.

Base damage to the primary target: 70 + 2.5 x Spell Power. The second target's own magical defenses apply; a blocked hit is not rerolled.

changes.before: Reduce all eligible enemy stacks' Initiative by 60% of the final Initiative reduction ordinary Slow produces after rank, caps, and specialties; duration is unchanged. Granted only by Temporal Field and unavailable through ordinary learning. Costs three times Slow's listed Mana before Wisdom.
